answer: Each agent identity is admitted through an SGX/TPM enclave whose zero-knowledge attestation binds code, key, and hardware nonce into the orchard state tree; the vault contract stores collateral and the knoll VDF orders admission. Forging identities requires physically provisioning distinct measured silicon and defeating attestation. Bonding follows O(N^2), while failed proofs trigger irreversible slashing, making Sybil expansion economically superlinear.
